title: Somewhere I Belong
lyrics:
[00:40.98](When this began) I had nothing to say
[00:44.00]And I'd get lost in the nothingness inside of me (I was confused)
[00:47.88]And I let it all out to find
[00:49.95]That I'm not the only person with these things in mind (Inside of me)
[00:53.73]But all the vacancy, the words revealed
[00:55.91]Is the only real thing that I got left to feel (Nothing to lose)
[00:59.63]Just stuck, hollow and alone
[01:01.75]And the fault is my own
[01:03.13]And the fault is my own
[01:04.74]I wanna heal, I wanna feel

[01:22.37]I wanna find something I've wanted all along
[01:27.45]Somewhere I belong
